status: Passed automatic dispatch, output/LSE correctness, and split/fused regressions on MI100.

method.selection: Normal automatic dispatch, with no manual image or backend override.
method.timing: Separate baseline/profiled processes; three rounds per case with 25 ms warmup, 100 ms repetition, and a 1 GiB cache flush between samples. Median of round medians; p50/p20/p80 values are milliseconds.
method.output_reference: MATH SDPA, FP32 for FP16/BF16 inputs and FP64 for FP32 inputs. Max absolute error <= max(2 * low-precision MATH reference error, 1e-6).
method.scope: Fixed-length forward kernel timings. End-to-end LLM performance and PyTorch built-in SDPA integration are not measured.
